resources.string: Store the key in the security chip

The key cannot be exported, moved to another phone or recovered. Uninstalling the app, clearing its data or resetting the phone may lose it. Keep the original .p12 file and its password somewhere safe outside the app.
I understand that I must keep my copy of the .p12 file
StrongBox is unavailable or does not support this key. Allow import into the trusted execution environment (TEE)?
The key has been stored and verified. Forgetting the reference does not delete your .p12 file. Keep your copy and its password so you can recover the certificate.
The key could not be stored. The .p12 file reference is preserved.
Delete the key from this device
The key cannot be recovered from this app. You will need your copy of the .p12 file to import it again.
Deletion is pending. The key is no longer available for signing.
